title: Binance Launches Commodity Options — Trade Gold and Silver Options with USDT
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,  Binance is bringing traditional markets to crypto-native trading. Commodity Options are now live: USDT- settled, European-style contracts built on Binance’s proven Options infrastructure. Trade gold and silver with the same speed and simplicity as crypto options. As part of Binance’s growing  TradFi  product suite, Commodity Options give traders a new way to express direction, trade volatility, and hedge, all from a single Binance account.    Key Highlights: A new dimension:  trade volatility and defined risk-strategies, not just direction.  Diversify your portfolio:  Gain exposure to traditional commodity markets, gold, silver directly from your Binance account. Defined risk for buyers:  Buyer’s max loss is the premium paid. No liquidation risk on long positions.  Hedge your TradFi exposure:  Use options to hedge existing positions.  Trade with USDT:  No underlying to hold. Trade and settle entirely in USDT. Limited-Time Promotion: Zero Maker Fees and Discount Taker Fees for Commodity Options Promotion Period:  2026-07-29 10:00 (UTC) until further notice Binance is introducing a limited-time promotion offering the following fee rates for  all users : Maker Fee Rate: 0.000% Taker Fee Rate: 0.020% This promotion provides users with one of the most competitive options fee structures in the market, featuring zero maker fees and lower taker fees on all Commodity Options trading during the Promotional Period. How to Start Trading Commodity Options on Binance: Log in to your Binance account and navigate to  [ Options ]  under the [Futures] tab. Choose your underlying asset (XAUUSDT, XAGUSDT). Select an expiration date and strike price. Choose  Buy Call  or  Buy Put . Enter the price and quantity, then click  [Buy]  to place the order. Commodity Options are also available via the  Binance App  and  API . Key Product Details: Feature Details Settlement USDT, cash-settled  Options Type European-style (exercised at expiry only) Expiry Structure 1-day and 1-week per underlying Strikes per Expiry Daily: ~10 strikes Weekly: ~12 strikes Trading Hours Follows underlying market sessions, closed during off-hours and weekends.  Modes  Retail users long only, buy to open, sell to close. No selling to open. Trading Hours & Sessions: Commodity Options follow the regular trading sessions of the underlying asset: Symbol Underlying Trading Hours  XAUUSDT Gold Same as underlying original trading hours: Sunday 6:00 PM (ET) to Friday 5:00 PM (ET). The market closes from 5:00 PM (ET) to 6:00 PM (ET) each day . XAGUSDT Silver Same as underlying original trading hours: Sunday 6:00 PM (ET) to Friday 5:00 PM (ET). The market closes from 5:00 PM (ET) to 6:00 PM (ET) each day. Important Note:  The market is  closed during off-hours . No new orders can be placed and existing orders are not matched during this time. Trading may also close early due to holidays. For more information on Commodity Options, including contract specifications, pricing and valuation, expiration and settlement, API reference, position limits, and risk management, please refer to the  FAQ .  A New Standard in Digital Asset Regulation: Binance is the first global crypto exchange to secure a comprehensive license under the  Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) framework , setting a new standard in digital asset regulation. The commodity options on Gold and Silver are traded on the FSRA-regulated exchange, Nest Exchange Limited, and cleared by the regulated clearing house, Nest Clearing and Custody Limited.
